name: video-template-frame-shuffle-kinetic-type
title: Shuffle Kinetic Type
description: A looping title card where the headline perpetually decrypts itself — each character cycles a random glyph and resolves left-to-right in a traveling wave, breathes through a weight/width pulse, then reverses and re-shuffles into the next word.
credits: Character decode/scramble wave inspired by Codrops "TypeShuffleAnimation" (MIT); rewired into an infinite self-driven director, no source copied.
Per-character overflow-hidden stagger inspired by Codrops "TypographyMotion" (MIT); pattern only.
Fluid type scale and easing tokens inspired by darkroomengineering/satus (MIT).

useCase.query: Use the Shuffle Kinetic Type HyperFrames template to create a 15s title-card video. Replace the sample headline/kicker/byline copy with real content, preserve the decode-wave / breathe / reverse motion signature and the infinite loop structure, and render to MP4.
